tasks.description: Enforce a 30-day retention policy for user activity data to meet GDPR compliance requirements. This involves designing and implementing an automated pipeline to delete data older than 30 days. The pipeline should be able to handle large volumes of data and ensure data consistency across all stores.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since its creation, then the record is automatically deleted from the primary event store.

tasks.description: Design and implement a data warehouse to store historical event logs for trend analysis. The warehouse should be able to handle large volumes of data and provide efficient querying capabilities. Ensure that the warehouse is scalable and secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a historical event log, when queried by an authorized user, then the log is returned in its entirety without any data loss or corruption.

tasks.description: Implement access controls to restrict data access to authorized personnel. Ensure that all access is logged for auditing purposes. The access controls should be role-based and enforce the principle of least privilege.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthorized user, when attempting to access user activity data, then access is denied and the attempt is logged.

tasks.description: Design and implement an automated job to delete user activity data older than 30 days. The job should be efficient, reliable, and able to handle large volumes of data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since its creation, then the record is automatically deleted by the deletion job.

tasks.description: Create documentation for the data retention policy, including its purpose, scope, and implementation details. Ensure that the documentation is clear, concise, and easily accessible to stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stakeholder, when requesting information about the data retention policy, then the documentation provides clear and accurate information.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing data to new warehouse
tasks.description: Migrate existing historical event logs to the new data warehouse. Ensure that the migration process is efficient, reliable, and does not result in any data loss or corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a historical event log, when migrated to the new warehouse, then the log is complete and accurate without any data loss or corruption.

tasks.description: Identify and fix any data consistency issues that may arise during the implementation of the data retention policy. Ensure that the fixes are thorough, reliable, and do not introduce any new issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when queried, then the record is consistent across all stores without any data inconsistencies or errors.
